what: On hover the button background pushes in from the left and fills. The leading edge is a 64-cell ramp baked from an 8×8 Bayer threshold (3px dots, 2px on phones), so dots lead sparsely, thicken, and a solid fill follows (.35s cubic-bezier(.5,1,.89,1)). The text turns dark over the same duration. When two arrows are stacked, the first slides out to the right and the second enters from the left. On leave it returns the same way

options.look: even (even slope 1 − u) · dense (slope packed toward the front — small icon cells), default even
options.--fx-hover-ink: Text color on hover, default var(--kf-ink)

use: Character — Icon cell uses data-fx-dither-ramp-hover="look: dense"

from.where: shared.css .sh-btn · .sh-cta-btn · .sh-issue__icon (original Button._-hover-background: ::before teal background, mask --mask-dither-ramp-default (64×8 Bayer linear ramp) + solid plate 200%, mask-position calc(0% − 64×dot)→calc(100% + 64×dot) · calc(200% − 64×dot)→100%, .35s --easing-out, text and icon ink-black, the two arrows swap by sliding with a 6px gap / the ISSUE + cell uses --mask-dither-ramp-dense)
